invented.quote: Every Sunday we deliver ten cooked meals to your door.
invented.why: The brief says meals are delivered every Sunday within 25 miles of downtown, not specifically to the customer's door.

invented.quote: We deliver to 88 customers each week
invented.why: The brief says there are 88 active customers and that customers can skip a week any time, not that all 88 receive a delivery every week.

invented.quote: and the average drop across all 14 was 0.6 points.
invented.why: The brief says the average drop was 0.6 points, without specifying whether that average was calculated across all 14 customers or only the 10 whose A1C went down.
